Swagbucks is one of the most popular of the beermoney sites. If you have not joined yet, sign up! REF / NON

Now, there are a ton of ways to earn, but there are a few that you can easily do every day to make consistent earnings, without too much work:

The rest at least 10 each -- Swagbucks seems to currently be playing with their maximums. Still, this is a total of at least 86 SB / day, which is about $0.86, for hardly any effort.

  • To Do List - On the left of the main Swagbucks page. Do the Daily Crave, the Daily Poll, and the NOSO (just click "More Deals" for each, to skip through them all). You will get a total of 4 SB for all of those, and they are quick.

  • Play Swagasaurus Run - Click "Play" at the top, and choose Swagasaurus run. Just keep dying quickly. You do not get extra points for higher scores. Play until you have earned 10 points (that is the limit per day).

After all of these, if you want to earn more, I recommend using "Discover - Encrave" and "Watch" to earn 3 SB for every 10 videos you watch (no effort but clicking occasionally).

Really, it is quick and easy to earn 100 SB or more every day, especially if you use all the apps. So easily an extra $30 a month!

Good luck!
